findings.title: 'Inflatable chamber' defined as a volume but claimed/described as the physical article
findings.attack: [0025] defines 'inflatable chamber' as an immaterial internal volume, but claim 64 claims it as 'comprising a bicycle inner tube' and [0031] equates it directly with the tube — a volume cannot comprise the tube that forms it, exposing claim 64 to a 112(b) indefiniteness attack.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Revise [0025]'s definition to the physical article, matching usage already present throughout the filed text; no new matter.

findings.title: [0078] contradicts the thermally actuated purge embodiment at [0142]
findings.attack: [0078]'s unqualified statement that no heating is involved in reaching the purge state directly contradicts [0142]'s thermally actuated purge, which opens the purge gap by warming.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Qualify [0078] to confine it to the over-travel-actuated embodiments, distinguishing the thermally actuated purge.

findings.title: Admission that a stainless-steel core body is an obvious corrosion remedy
findings.attack: [0176] characterises the brass-corrosion problem and the stainless-steel solution as 'a matter of general materials knowledge,' handing an examiner/opponent a ready-made obviousness argument against claim 54 standing alone.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Reframe [0176] to describe the corrosion consideration without characterising the stainless-steel response as a matter of general knowledge 'for that reason'.

findings.title: Admitted sealant-retention drawback in claimed slotted/cellular wall species
findings.attack: [0086] admits the slotted wall, cellular wall and openings-through-the-wall species (claimed in 15 and 32) can themselves retain liquid sealant, undercutting the invention's stated self-cleaning purpose for those specific claimed alternatives.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a sentence noting the air purge acts on these openings too, tempering the admission with the already-disclosed countervailing mechanism.

findings.title: Apparent tension between [0078]'s 'no heating' statement and the thermally actuated purge
findings.attack: [0078]'s unqualified statement that 'no heating... is involved in reaching the purge state' appears to contradict [0142]'s later-disclosed thermally actuated purge, which an opponent could cite as an internal contradiction bearing on enablement of, or amendment basis for, the thermal variant.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Scope [0078] explicitly to the mechanically actuated embodiments described in that section.

findings.title: Overbroad admission that pre-over-travel operation is conventional
findings.attack: "in the same manner as a conventional valve core" could be read broadly enough to admit the seat ring's sealing role as prior art, beyond the narrower point intended.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Narrow the comparison to the specific crack-pressure/sealing behaviour intended, without touching the purge-gap function.

findings.title: No problem/solution summary precedes the Definitions section (EPO Rule 42(1)(c))
findings.attack: The description opens directly with interpretive Definitions and never states the technical problem and general solution in a single summary paragraph, as EPO Rule 42(1)(c) requires.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a short summary paragraph ahead of the Definitions section stating the problem and solution at a level no narrower than claim 1.

findings.title: Inconsistent parenthetical convention for reference numerals in the description
findings.attack: Paragraphs [0031]-[0041] cite numerals without parentheses while [0042] onward use parentheses, contrary to EPC Rule 43(7)'s parenthetical convention.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Standardise [0031]-[0041] to the parenthetical form used from [0042] onward.

findings.title: Inconsistent reference-sign practice across the claim set
findings.attack: Claims 79-89 omit reference numerals used consistently for the same components in claims 1, 58, 67 and 90-102.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add the existing reference numerals to claims 79-89 at first mention.

findings.title: Independent claims not in EPO/UK two-part form
findings.attack: Rule 43(1) EPC requires a two-part preamble/characterising-portion claim form wherever appropriate; the independent claims are single-part throughout.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Defer reformatting to EPO/UK regional-phase entry once the closest prior art is fixed by a search report.

findings.title: No statement that reference signs in the claims are non-limiting
findings.attack: Absence of the customary disclaimer sharpens the risk of numerals in the claims being read as limiting (see F-37-3).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a standard non-limiting reference-sign disclaimer sentence at [0001].

findings.title: Abstract, drawing sheets, brief description of drawings and field/background/summary absent; [0160] refers to a missing background
findings.attack: An abstract is required in the US, at the EPO and in the UK; a brief description of the drawings is required by 37 CFR 1.74 and EPC Rule 42(1)(d). Drawings relied on throughout but not filed trigger EPO Rule 56 and US 35 U.S.C. 113 consequences. [0160]'s cross-reference points to no background section.
findings.least_narrowing_action: The owning drafter supplies the abstract, the list of figures, the field/background/summary and the drawing sheets (from stripped instructions), and points [0160] at the background or rewords it to 'both failure modes, leak-down and blockage, as defined herein'.

findings.title: Axial layout of seat ring, sealing edge, internal shoulder and chamber-side purge shoulder cannot be reconstructed from the text
findings.attack: The poppet opens towards the chamber, so the sealing face lies on the chamber side of the sealing edge; a purge shoulder on the chamber side of the sealing face then moves away from a ring whose 2.3 mm bore admits only the stem, and [0116] puts the sealing edge at the supply-side end. With no drawing sheets, the preferred embodiment of claims 3 and 4 cannot be built from the words (Art. 83/84; 112(a)).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add one paragraph, from the inventor's FIG-1 sketch, stating the axial order of the parts, and draw it; if the shoulder is not on the chamber side of the sealing face, conform [0021], [0038], [0112] and claim 3.

findings.title: Claim structure not adapted to US multiple-dependency rules or EPO Rule 43(2)
findings.attack: Multiple dependent claims serve as the basis for other multiple dependent claims (for example claim 10 on claims 8 and 9, claim 13 via claim 10, claims 61, 64, 89 and 99), which is improper under 35 U.S.C. 112(e) and 37 CFR 1.75(c): such claims are not examined on the merits. There are three or more independent product claims (1, 58, 67), which needs a Rule 43(2) justification; the 102 claims also carry excess-claim fees in all three offices.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Counsel prepares a US claim set with single dependencies and prepares the EPO interrelated-products justification; no scope is narrowed.

findings.title: Illustrated embodiment's outward deflection said to open an outer-surface clearance that the description says needs inward movement
findings.attack: Outward movement of the outer surface towards the core body bore narrows the clearance between them and cannot open it; [0103] itself says such a gap opens by inward movement. The only built embodiment and FIG. 3/10B as instructed therefore depict a mechanism the specification rules out. The FIG. 1 instructions draw a clearance at rest, contradicting 'purge gap closed'. This draws Art. 84/112 objections against claims 29 and 30 and undermines the evidential weight of Example 1.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Get the inventor to confirm the prototype's actual kinematics, then conform [0020], [0040], [0053], [0054], [0093] and the FIG. 1/3/6/10B instructions (using the wording of [0103] if the gap opens by inward movement). No claim narrowing.

findings.title: Wipe-only embodiment disclosed but outside every independent claim
findings.attack: A competitor seals the ring periphery so that no purge flow path exists and keeps the over-travel deflection and recovery wipe of the sealing face. [0167] shows the clean surfaces are the wiped ones. This escapes claims 1, 58 and 79 (all require the purge gap and purge flow path), and escapes claim 67 outside the dimensional window.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add an independent valve-core claim, supported by [0065], [0124] and [0061], reciting over-travel radial deflection of the ring and recovery movement across a poppet surface, without the purge gap; claim 1 is kept.

findings.title: 'About', 'approximately' and 'nominally' in claims while [0007] disclaims any tolerance
findings.attack: [0007] states the qualifiers define no numerical tolerance, removing the guidance needed to construe them; this draws an Art. 84/112(b) objection, and in litigation these fallbacks become point values or indefinite.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Recite the disclosed worked values without the qualifier in these fallback claims, or add a tolerance only if the inventor has one.

findings.title: [0009] invites means-plus-function construction of deflectable ring element, deflecting formation and threshold-setting arrangement
findings.attack: The wording 'any structure capable of performing the recited function, consistent with the corresponding structures described ... and their equivalents' concedes a 35 U.S.C. 112(f)-style construction, limiting the central claim-1 term to the described structures and their equivalents in US litigation.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Replace the second sentence of [0009] with structural definitions (as in [0014], [0021], [0022]) and delete 'corresponding structures ... and their equivalents'; counsel to consider structural wording in claim 36.

findings.title: Figure plan and registry carry internal working references, stale flags and a FIG. 6A call-out mismatch
findings.attack: The instructions contain dossier references (11.md, 13.md, 14.md, DA codes, Prompt 20 Assumption A2), prejudicial statements ('cannot be closed without new matter', 'the inventor states doubt'), and a deferred cross-check that is now stale. [0089] says the dimensions are called out in FIG. 6A, but the instructions call out none. Numeral style is inconsistent ('seat ring 30' in [0030]-[0041] against 'seat ring (30)' from [0042]).
findings.least_narrowing_action: Strip all internal references from the instructions before the drawings are commissioned, add the dimension call-outs to FIG. 6A, re-run the registry cross-check, and unify the numeral style to parentheses.

findings.title: Kit has no claim and the component claim is dimension-bound
findings.attack: A supplier sells the matched seat ring, poppet and spring kit without a core body, or a seat ring outside claim 67's Presta window; only uncertain indirect infringement is then available.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Add a kit claim supported by [0141] (matched seat ring, poppet with purge shoulder and two-stage return spring giving the claim-1 states when assembled into a core body).

findings.title: Over-travel by depressor, by hand, during deflation only, or by a separate purge actuator falls outside claims 1, 58 and 79
findings.attack: Claim 1 defines the purge state by 'a pressure differential exceeding the over-travel threshold' with the poppet itself in over-travel. A depressor-only core (Schrader, or Presta with an adaptor), a deflation-only core, or the purge-actuator design ('the poppet performing only its normal stroke') arguably has no such state.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Reformulate the claim-1 purge state as over-travel produced by the pressure differential exceeding the threshold or by mechanical depression of the poppet (support [0066]), and add a claim to the purge-actuator form (support [0123]).

findings.title: No ranges for normal stroke, interference or shape-setting window
findings.attack: The normal stroke and axial clearance, the interference and the shape-setting time/temperature are given as single values only, leaving single-point fallbacks for parameters a teardown can measure.
findings.least_narrowing_action: Ask the inventor for ranges they actually conceived; do not generate them.
